descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-11 Course Timeline · S17 The course refresh fails, returns nothing usable, or races a timeline edit: today's line is still finished and the physician is told

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 A new timeline entry is created automatically on every completed note, generated from that day's finished note. (TFA-92589 AC 2; TFA-92589 description 1)
  • U1 One entry per completed visit, correctly dated, in chronological order, never duplicated. (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 3)
  • U6 Entries never contain signature blocks or placeholders (e.g. '[Physician name]'). (UAT TC-11; TFA-92589 AC 6; TFA-92589 2026-10-02 comment)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Hospital patient and resident with today's pre-round line; the course refresh is mocked to fail, to return an entry that scrubs to empty, or to resolve 5 s late

When Finish the note in each context; in the late cell, save a Course / Visit Timeline edit while the refresh is still running, then let it resolve

Then Fail cell: today's line is still there, marked finished, not duplicated, and a message says the course / visit timeline couldn't be refreshed. Scrub-to-empty cell: today's line is not left a bare 'Encounter done' without that message. Late cell: the physician's edit is stored byte-for-byte, and either today's entry is written or the physician is told

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in course-timeline.spec.ts (stored ledger + visible message). Whether '<date>: Encounter done' is an acceptable entry or a placeholder, and whether a retry is owed, is Q11: a Pass on the fail cell proves the line is not lost, not that AC 2/6 hold. The scrub-to-empty and late cells have no test on main and report Blocked (not built); …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-11.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).

UAT item: TC-11 Course Timeline · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-11/S17

The course refresh fails, returns nothing usable, or races a timeline edit: today's line is still finished and the physician is told

Tickets: TFA-92589 Course Timeline (ready for qa)

Re-verdict after the QA review of TFA-92589 (2026-10-14; not yet checked by Quinn): needs a person. Only the refresh-failure cells (both modes) are tested; an entry cleaned to empty and a late refresh after the physician edited the timeline were not written (code reading: both keep 'Encounter done' with no message and keep the physician's edit). The run's own result was pass; its evidence is below.

Result: passed in matrix/TC-11.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed hospital course refresh still leaves today's line finished — expected
  • course-timeline.spec.ts [chromium] — a failed nursing-home course refresh still leaves today's line finished — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (Tim's specs in e2e/course-timeline.spec.ts plus our cells not written yet): the course refresh is mocked to fail, to scrub to empty or to resolve late (mockNoteFinish), on fresh @roundai.test accounts seeded with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and no action mock, so it runs on …. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
